## What it is

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Step into the world of Palazzo Moroni, an enchanting palace nestled in the heart of a picturesque Italian town.
>
> Admire its stunning interiors, adorned with magnificent frescoes and intricate stucco work.
>
> Stroll around the meticulously manicured gardens, where the vibrant blooms and soothing fountains make you feel like you're in a fairytale!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €16.19. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 44 ratings and 25 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from
